verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail's own docs say mailbox users can ship packages to any address and save by bundling them, which covers package forwarding and consolidation. The address also handles shipments, returns and mail forwarding. Missing for 10: explicit acceptance of packages from all major carriers (UPS/FedEx/DHL/Amazon), any hold-for-local-pickup option, detail on consolidation limits or storage periods, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
